briefdescription.para: This template implementation resides in a separate file so that it does not get injected into every .cpp file that includes the generic header.

detaileddescription.para: DO NOT INCLUDE THIS FILE WHEN MERELY USING CYCLEINFO.

This file should only be included by files that implement a specialization of the relevant templates. Currently these are:
llvm/lib/IR/CycleInfo.cpp
llvm/lib/CodeGen/MachineCycleAnalysis.cpp
